title: feat(ui): auto-open the update modal once per new version
context:
The update pill was easy to miss; the update flow only ran for users who
noticed and clicked it. When /api/version/check reports the install is
behind, the update modal now opens itself on load -- once per new version,
suppressed per version in localStorage so dismissal doesn't nag, and
skipped while the First Flight tour owns first-run. Pill and manual
click-to-open unchanged.

Verified headless with an intercepted version check: auto-opens on first
load, stays closed after dismiss+reload, manu
decision: Introduced static/app.js: added updDismissedFor, updMarkDismissed, updAutoOpen.
